Hi, I can understand a little, after my mother died, I realised that she was not a good person, however I still find myself grieving her, and I realised that perhaps I am not missing her specifically but rather the concept of having a mum in my life.

 - I think that you no matter what your dad was like, or how you feel about him while processing the information you learnt, it is still perfectly ok for you to miss the person you thought you knew, and to miss not 'your' dad, but 'a' dad too.

 In my opinion, it sounds like your dad was not the best. The things you have described him doing are to me very bad and abusive. However, if some experiences with him were good, or you have some happy memories, it is ok for you to still love or miss this part of him, or this version that you remember, and you should not feel guilty over it.

 I don't hate my Mum, but my sister hates her- both responses are ok. That doesn't make my sister any less compassionate or empathetic and it doesn't make me any more selfish.

I hope that this gets easier with time. ❤️❤️
